notes.title: New Build Posted (June 15)
notes.content:
[h1]New Modding Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fully customizable procedural world generation
[*] Brand new procedural landmark naming affix? system
[*] Ability to mark special ares in landmarks for reference in world blueprints
[*] End Goal customization
[*] Full ambient music customization with Music Blueprints
[*] Ambient color customization
[*] Landmark entry sound customization
[*] Ability to add fully customizable messages anywhere in the world
[*] Global inventory/bundle blueprint abstraction
[*] Recursive Inventory/Bundle Blueprint definition
[*] Custom in-game map details and hex messages while creating landmark blueprints
[*] More detailed debugging notifications while modding
[*] Ability to connect directly to saved gridspace states.
[*] Added multi-line comment functionality
[*] Ability to spawn test-only equipment, critters and bundles.
[/list]
[h1]Enhanced Cave Textures[/h1]
[h1]Review recent messages with “Enter” key[/h1]
[h1]Assorted bug fixes[/h1]

notes.title: New Build - Blueprints Feature Expanded
notes.content:
Venture Forth Blueprints allow you to not only customize your levels, but to build an entire game from scratch using Arclight Worlds' custom engine. Jeremy Ingham's very easy to understand building language is easy to learn and contains very simple but powerful commands that'll enable you to not only build incredible worlds of your very own, but now you can blueprint your very own equipment and critters. 

Check out my tutorial in the Guides section to get a running start. New versions of the guide coming out this weekend.

- indievoyagerob

notes.title: Latest Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1] Patch Notes: 16.08.18.14	[/h1]
Hey everybody, these patch notes are a bit late (we'll get better at it, promise :D ). Below is a full list of the added and altered features. 

Please comment and rate the game. We're looking forward to seeing your comments and responding in kind. 

As always, enjoy :).
	[b]Indie Voyage and Arclight Worlds[/b]

[h1] New Equipment Menu Layout: 	[/h1]
[list]
	[*] New Stat Star gives a quick summary of all your current stats/stat changes.
	[*] Can now see available equipment for all equipmnet slots, and thus quickly choose and equip each one.
	[*] An item’s specific details can be shown by right clicking on it or pressing ‘Q’.
[/list]

[h1] Altered Stat Mechanics: 		[/h1]
[list]	
	[*] All stats cut by a factor of 10 in order to have small, easy to work with numbers.
	[*] Damage is now quantized into whole numbers.
	[*] Armor is now shown instead of Defense:
	[*] Armor > 0: Defense = (1-10/(Armor+10)) * 100%
	[*] Armor < 0: Defense = Armor/10 * 100%
	[*] Polished up first-time calibration tests.
[/list]

[h1] New sound effects added for: [/h1]
[list]
	[*] Lava
	[*] Genie
	[*] Golem
	[*] Dragon
[/list]

[h1] New Golem Mechanics: [/h1]
[list]	
	[*] Barrier (Artifact): Orbiting stones knock back melee attackers. Dropped upon death.
	[*] Rock Throw: Ranged projectile with knockback.
	[*] Rock Slam: Slams the ground with a massive elemental explosion, knocking back all other creatures.
[/list]
